proof_body:
by
  intro F f a b hab hF hu
  have hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b) := hu.continuousOn (Filter.Frequently.of_forall hF)
  have hfi : IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume a b := hf.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hab
  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
  intro ε hε
  have hpos : 0 < b - a + 1 := by linarith
  have hδ : 0 < ε / (b - a + 1) := div_pos hε hpos
  rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff] at hu
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 (hu _ hδ)
  refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  rw [Real.dist_eq, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub ((hF n).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hab) hfi]
  have hb : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIoc a b, ‖F n x - f x‖ ≤ ε / (b - a + 1) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hab] at hx
    have h₁ := hN n hn x ⟨hx.1.le, hx.2⟩
    rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] at h₁
    exact h₁.le
  have h₂ := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hb
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hab)] at h₂
  calc |∫ x in a..b, F n x - f x| ≤ ε / (b - a + 1) * (b - a) := h₂
    _ < ε := by
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_iff₀ hpos]
      nlinarith
target_source: ∀ (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), a ≤ b → (∀ n, ContinuousOn (F n) (Set.Icc a b)) → TendstoUniformlyOn F f Filter.atTop (Set.Icc a b) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in a..b, F n x) Filter.atTop (nhds (∫ x in a..b, f x))
